title: Changing an individual shader for a tile via _tile_data_runtime_update
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7] v4.5.dev2.official [af2c713]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable

### Issue description

In issue godotengine/godot-proposals#12174, it was suggested to use _tile_data_runtime_update as a workaround for transparency. Although this approach is more performance-intensive, it does work. 

However, in my case, I need to change the material for a specific tile on the map.

### Steps to reproduce

Access to TileData is available, and the documentation clearly states that the resource must be duplicated - this is also evident from the fact that the shader would otherwise be changed for all tiles of the same type. So, I do the following:
```gdscript
extends TileMapLayer

func _use_tile_data_runtime_update(coords: Vector2i) -> bool:
	return coords.x < 10

func _tile_data_runtime_update(coords: Vector2i, tileData: TileData) -> void:
	# works
	#tileData.modulate.a = 0.5
	
	# works to all
	#tileData.material.set_shader_parameter("color", Color(0, 1, 0))
	
	# no works
	var clone: ShaderMaterial = tileData.material.duplicate()
	clone.resource_local_to_scene = true
	print(clone," <-> ",tileData.material)
	
	clone.set_shader_parameter("color", Color(0, 1, 0))
	tileData.material = clone
```

Console:
```
<ShaderMaterial#-9223372006588676771> <-> <ShaderMaterial#-9223372007360428718>
<ShaderMaterial#-9223372006555122337> <-> <ShaderMaterial#-9223372007360428718>
<ShaderMaterial#-9223372006521567903> <-> <ShaderMaterial#-9223372007360428718>
<ShaderMaterial#-9223372006488013469> <-> <ShaderMaterial#-9223372007360428718>
...
```
(You can notice that these are different shaders)

However, this doesn't work and results in the following error:
```
E 0:00:00:221   material_get_instance_shader_parameters: Parameter "material" is null.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/material_storage.cpp:2340 @ material_get_instance_shader_parameters()

E 0:00:00:221   material_update_dependency: Parameter "material" is null.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/material_storage.cpp:2352 @ material_update_dependency()
```

I couldn't find any information regarding this issue, so it's either a bug, or I'm doing something wrong — in which case, I would like to ask: what exactly am I doing wrong?

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bae249e2-13ea-4a3a-9407-36452d2893d0

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[shadertest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19735243/shadertest.zip)
